descriptionEn: An airy bouquet in a soft pink-and-white palette with a rounded silhouette, layered textures, fresh green accents, and elegant light wrapping finished with satin ribbons. Delicate and intimate in mood, it suits a romantic gesture, a graceful birthday greeting, or a tender personal message.
